producer_checks.information_cutoff: 17 Nov 21:30 BRT / 18 Nov 00:30 UTC. US and Brazilian equity figures refer to the 17 Nov regular closes. Nvidia results follow the regular US close. Eurostat full October HICP, Fed minutes and Brazilian fiscal votes are scheduled for 18 Nov.
producer_checks.novelty: Replaces the early edition's 16 Nov market snapshot with the 17 Nov close and adds October US retail sales, import prices and industrial production, Nvidia's fiscal Q3 results and outlook, the latest oil settlements and the PLP 299/2026 postponement.
producer_checks.evidence_vintage: Census advance October nominal retail sales are seasonally adjusted. The BLS October import price indexes are unadjusted. Federal Reserve G.17 October industrial production is seasonally adjusted. Treasury yields are nominal daily par yields. B3, AP, UOL and Reuters market observations use named venues or instruments. Nvidia GAAP results refer to the fiscal quarter ended 25 October, and outlook is conditional. Eurostat October HICP remains the flash estimate at cutoff.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Both editions use the same 14 sources, chart series, major reference dates, market conventions and scenario tests.
producer_checks.visual_evidence: Two sourced charts, closing-market and scenario tables, a regional exposure map and two conditional transmission mechanisms.
producer_checks.qa_rework: Retains the correction to Eurostat's 18 November release date. Closing revision requires independent review of all three revised blobs.

limitations: The Census retail sales estimate is nominal and its monthly confidence interval includes zero.
Market snapshots have different cutoffs and do not identify causal effects or private borrowing costs.
Nvidia revenue is an observed supplier result, while its outlook is guidance and says little by itself about customer utilization and investment returns.
The oil surplus is an IEA forecast. The effect of local disruption on landed costs depends on actual shipping, freight and insurance.
The fiscal improvement estimate is conditional on the final text and implementation. The official October euro-area HICP is preliminary at cutoff.
contrary_evidence: A fall in nominal sovereign yields coexisted with broad US equity losses.
US manufacturing output rose overall despite the fall in total industrial output, while manufacturing excluding vehicles and parts edged down.
Brent rebounded despite the IEA's fourth-quarter surplus forecast.
Brazilian shares rebounded while the commercial dollar rose.

en.title: Global Macro — US retail growth slows, import prices rise and Brazil delays fiscal vote
en.deck: US retail sales rose 0.2% in October and import prices rose 1.1%. Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in revenue after the close. Brazil's Senate moved remaining fiscal votes to 18 November.
en.regime: Slower US nominal retail growth with rising import costs, alongside a broad equity selloff and a post-close AI supplier earnings release.
en.key_risk: Rising replacement costs can compress margins while oil transport risk and uncertain fiscal execution complicate price and credit transmission.
